convergence.interpretation: Diagnostic reference for accumulated legacy+new estimates; no automatic new-replica quota or mandatory recalculation. The current sampling plan is finite and ends for assessment.

duration_policy: Primary refinement starts from verified legacy20ps spectra and adds two20ps windows per new40ps trajectory. Own volume and temperature for every replica; never temporal concatenation. Separate new40/first20/second20 diagnostics do not enforce a new30-replica series.
restart_policy: Only inherited single ID20988268 can requeue before20h; no new sbatch. All other previous temperature jobs superseded.
preparation_note: New independent seeded reservoir from archived pureTi configuration,20psNPT then5psNPT+1psNVT+40psNVT per newreplica;legacy preparation remains separately identified.

scheduling.policy: Single job round-robin; external versioned plan specifies which five-replica blocks to add to existing statistics. No compulsory new replica quota.

pooling.weight: Equal-length20ps channels pooled without temporal concatenation;ownV/(kB*T),fivechannels
pooling.uncertainty: max(formalSE,delete-one-whole-replica cluster jackknifeSE);both halves removed together for newreplicas
pooling.legacy_model_validation: All archived zero-step pressures must match checkpoint23200 before submission
pooling.extension_policy: No Nnew>=30 requirement. Primary statistics start with all verified legacy replicas. Each added block is analyzed immediately; new40ps windows are additional diagnostics. Extension beyond the current plan requires a new recorded sampling decision.
